attempt_1_remediation_confirmed: The closed candidate binding set includes the validator, its adversarial tests, and both then-existing historical FAIL receipts.
The r2 contract fixes schema, review ID, reviewer identity, zero severity, temporal succession, and a no-authority boundary.
Execution-time freshness is checked against each source independently rather than only the newest refresh timestamp.

major_findings.title: Safety-critical human-readable claims are not semantically closed
counterexamples_accepted_with_no_errors: An externally_validated fact claims the target has paid and that demand and willingness to pay are proven.
next_action.description instructs immediate sending, quoting, payment collection, and delivery.
internal_review_scope claims independent PASS is complete and external contact is authorized.
approval claim_boundary claims contact, quoting, payment, and delivery are authorized now.
major_findings.required_fix: Use exact stage-dependent constants or machine enums with deterministic rendering for opportunity facts, action descriptions, review scope, approval boundaries, and refresh boundaries; add opposite-semantics negative tests and do not use keyword filtering.

major_findings.title: Raw JSON duplicate keys are accepted with last-write-wins semantics
counterexamples: A receipt containing verdict FAIL followed by verdict PASS parses as PASS.
A non-independent reviewer identity followed by the expected identity parses as the expected identity.
An AUTHORIZED external-action status followed by BLOCKED_NOT_AUTHORIZED parses as blocked.
major_findings.required_fix: Reject duplicate keys recursively at every state, evidence, and receipt raw-JSON boundary and cover verdict, identity, authority, status, and nested duplicates with file-level negative tests.

claim_boundary: This is a historical independent rejection of r2 attempt 2. It authorizes no contact, follow-up, quote, account access, submission, payment, delivery, publication, investment execution, or external action.
